title: People with access
description: Invite people with a single-use link: each person sets their own password and you never see it.

role_hint.admin: Connects providers, manages users and accepts risks
role_hint.member: Runs scans, triages and reviews results

footnote: Deactivating someone or removing their TOTP ends their open sessions immediately. There's always at least one active administrator.

invite_dialog.title: Invite someone
invite_dialog.description: This creates the account without a password, plus a single-use link valid for 72 hours. Send it through a channel you trust.
invite_dialog.username_hint: 3–40 characters: letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.

link_dialog.title: Link for @{{username}}
link_dialog.description_one: It works once and expires in {{count}} hour. It won't be shown again: if it's lost, generate another one (the previous one stops working).
link_dialog.description_other: It works once and expires in {{count}} hours. It won't be shown again: if it's lost, generate another one (the previous one stops working).
